n: Titled ‘for Solomon,’ the temple builder. Unless the Lord builds a house — a home, a family, or a temple — the builders’ work is wasted; unless he guards a city, the watchman stays awake for nothing.

f.w: Except the LORD build the house

n: Anxious overwork — rising early, staying up late, eating the bread of worry — is pointless without God. He gives rest to those he loves.
Children are a gift and inheritance from God, not just the result of human effort.

f.w: children are an heritage of the LORD

n: Children born when parents are young are like arrows in a warrior’s hand — strength and protection for the family.

f.w: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man
f.g: Children as a family’s defense and future.

n: Happy is the man with a full quiver of them. When disputes arose at the city gate — where courts were held — his sons would stand up for him.

f.g: The city gate, where elders held court and business.
